discovery.summary: Compare a Treasury average rate with a threshold
discovery.description: Select exactly one latest monthly Treasury average-interest-rate category from the official Fiscal Data dataset and compare its weighted-average rate on outstanding debt with a caller threshold. Returns threshold_met, threshold_not_met, or human_review for missing/ambiguous data. These are monthly averages on outstanding debt, not live market yields or rates for a specific new issuance.
discovery.resource_description: Compare the latest official monthly weighted-average interest rate for one U.S. Treasury security category to a caller threshold. Returns threshold_met, threshold_not_met, or human_review. This is not a live market yield, forecast, or investment recommendation.

buyer.task: Compare the latest official monthly average interest rate for one U.S. Treasury security category with a caller-selected threshold.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

sources.authority: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
sources.refresh_policy: live fetch of the latest official monthly dataset on each paid request

rules: Require one unambiguous latest-month Treasury security description match.
Require a finite official average interest rate.
For operator gte, return threshold_met when rate is at or above thresholdPercent; for lte, return threshold_met when rate is at or below thresholdPercent.
Return human_review when Treasury evidence is unavailable, missing, ambiguous, or lacks a usable rate.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Commercial promotion remains blocked until complete unit economics meet the target or an explicit exception is approved.
